paragraphs: Creditspring’s aim to give members reliable short‑term financial products aligns with my work on an MCP‑based agentic tool that streamlines decision support for a Madrid‑based product start‑up, improving user stability through data‑driven insights.
I proposed and prototyped the FastMCP agent in Python, using Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo.
I built scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker.
Could we schedule a brief call so I can walk you through how these solutions could support Creditspring’s subscription products?”
